title: Examples of Ignorance In Various Subjects

lists.name: IGNORANCE IN ASTRONOMY OR COSMOLOGY
lists.of: an example of ignorance in astronomy or cosmology
items: Amount and location of cosmic antimatter.
Any teleological infrastructure of the universe and cosmology.
Cause and importance of the coincidental agreement of several disparate energy-densities of the Milky Way Galaxy.
Cause of sunspots and the sunspot cycle.
Causes of the upper-atmospheric superrotations of earth and venus.
Composition, structure, and energy of the galactic center.
Constancy of the sun and stars.
Cosmogonic origins and causes of fundamental physical constants, laws, entities, and relationships.
Dimensions, origins, and causes of gamma-ray bursts.
Existence and possible extent of lunar volcanism.
Existence of metallic hydrogen at Jupiter's core.
Existence, location, range, incidence, and importance of black holes.
Extra-ecliptic structure of the solar system.
Fineness of detail of nebulae within many orders of magnitude.
Frequency and types of natural interstellar visitants.
Height of chemical evolution within Jupiter.
History and causes of global and local paleomagnetic excursions.
History and magnitude of galactic violence.
History of the universe at infinitesimal ages.
How special our cosmic spatial location is.
How sunspots are able to persist at all.
LONGEST PHOTONS: finitude, quantity, spectrum, total energy, origin, and roles.
Long-term stability of the solar system.
Meaning and degree of cosmic security.
Mass, energy, and entropy of the universe.
Mineral differentiation and wealth of other planetaries.
Nature of Jupiter's Great Red Spot.
Reason for the superhot outer-atmospheric layers of the sun and earth.
Roles of electrical and magnetic forces in solar system phenomena.
Size and shape of the heliosphere.
Sun's role in earth's weather, climate, and past history.
Temperature at the center of Jupiter, the moon, and earth.

notes: NOTA BENE: These are either examples of ignorance or of things about which we are profoundly ignorant. There are 536 irredundant examples, but many reappear under the headings of other subjects. Item 44 is obscured, and the photographed chart continues beyond the bottom edge.
